verdict.rationale: Salv has a documented public API covering data upload (CSV and addPerson/addTransaction), real-time monitoring checks, alert status updates, manual alert creation and updates, risk factor fetching, webhooks, and Custom Lists configuration. The docs say only 'some of the configuration' is available via the API, and token invalidation is a UI action, which shows the API does not match the UI. Missing for 10: API parity for scenario/flow configuration, backtesting, case management, clearance and good-listing rules, credential management, and any statement of full UI–API parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
